page: Microsoft Azure NV4ads_V710_v5 is a virtualized server instance powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and an AMD processor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes a fractional GPU allocation of 0.1667 of an AMD V710 GPU, providing 4 GB of dedicated VRAM.

For local storage, the instance is equipped with a 275 GB NVMe SSD. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput external disk attachments. The configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The fractional GPU allocation offers a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage, allowing users to access hardware-accelerated graphics and compute capabilities without the expense of provisioning a full, dedicated GPU. This resource density makes the instance appropriate for entry-level virtual desktops, lightweight 3D rendering, GPU-accelerated application streaming, and general-purpose workloads that benefit from modest hardware acceleration and local NVMe storage.
